svg.title: Gaffer agent workflow
svg.desc: Three columns: Perceive (OpenCV tools check_frame_quality, reanalyse_window, render_evidence), Decide (rules, Nova 2 Lite, guard and budgets) and Act (record_decision, evidence image, propose_alert, the coach). A highlighted loop shows a real trace where an OpenCV result changed the next call. Every candidate ends confirmed, rejected or uncertain; every step is logged.

g.text: Perceive with OpenCV, decide with rules, act only with the coach’s approval.
nothing is sent without the coach
Camera still? Pitch lines fitted? Any cut?
Re-reads the window at 4 to 6 fps
Budget: 360 s per call, 1,200 s per match
Picks the next tool and words the reason
At most 8 LLM and 3 vision calls per candidate
Rules-only fallback if Bedrock is down
confirmed, rejected or uncertain, with citations
status pending, waits for the coach
OpenCV result changes the next call
highest rate, as coverage was low

svg.text: Honest reading: the first pass alone would also have confirmed. OpenCV chose the path (6 fps) and built the evidence.

g.text: no alert, the reason is shown
e.g. camera moved, over budget, clip too short
tool calls · tokens + cost · coach decisions
